answer: Starve sybils with co-signing rings: a new identity joins the agent economy only after several long-standing identities co-sign it, each staking collateral against its future behavior. A puppet army then needs real co-signers per fake, and co-signers lose their stake when a puppet cheats, so attack cost scales with the honest ocean of staked agents backing the ring. Suspect clusters are held in a review haven where peers trace their funding through the nebula of anonymous routes until real wallets surface, and offenders forfeit the whole co-signed chain.
